injuries.description: minor chemical burn on the face
source: As a result of the attack, the Plaintiff sustained minor chemical burn on the face and stab wound of about 3 cm. long in the right thigh.
In respect of the facial injury, there are still a few small scars left on the face. These facial scars are not ugly and are only noticeable at short distance.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of part of head

injuries.description: stab wound of about 3 cm. long in the right thigh
source: As a result of the attack, the Plaintiff sustained minor chemical burn on the face and stab wound of about 3 cm. long in the right thigh.
The latter wound healed properly with a small residual scar.
injuries.icd_description: Puncture wound without foreign body of hip or thigh

injuries.description: posttraumatic stress disorder and depression caused by the incident on 25 April 1997
source: 23.1 She is suffering from posttraumatic stress disorder. ... The disorder is caused by the trauma of the incident on 25 April 1997 and the resultant scars over her face and thigh, and is consistent with the injury.
23.2 She is displaying symptoms of depression. ... The depression is caused by the problems with her husband and child care, and the aftermath of the incident.
29. I estimate the degree of permanent impairment to the whole person, due to posttraumatic stress disorder and depression caused by the incident on 25 April 1997, at 3%.

manifestations.description: distressful re-experience of the traumatic event
avoidance of stimuli associated with the trauma
displeased with the scar of her face and thigh
